fusions.name: Glancing Tine
fusions.desc: Clips the target with an antler as you bound past. It deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter and Bolt
fusions.desc: You bolt through the press and startle it: the rush deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Snare
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 control conditions from you. You move 30% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sudden Swerve
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
